load_glue_metric: load the glue sst2 metric module using evaluate.load for sentiment analysis evaluation
launch_gradio_widget: launch a gradio widget for the glue sst2 metric module to interactively evaluate predictions
evaluate_glue_predictions: evaluate glue sst2 predictions against labels using the loaded metric module
compute_glue_accuracy: compute accuracy scores for glue sst2 task predictions with the evaluate module
run_glue_metric_demo: run the glue sst2 metric gradio demo to test text classification predictions interactively
